final_topology.title: Azure Hub-Spoke Network
final_topology.description: A hub-and-spoke Azure network with centralized security and management.
final_topology.topology_summary: The hub contains an Azure Firewall and Azure Bastion. Spokes are VNETs for identity, operations, and workloads, with all inter-spoke traffic routed through the hub firewall.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' node (n12) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z8), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) and 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for management and monitoring.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' node (n13) in the 'Documentation' zone (z9), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) and 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for management and monitoring.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology shows multiple VNETs (Identity, Operations, Workload, Non-Production) that are peered with the Hub VNet, indicating segmentation of data processing and storage based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to various nodes and VNETs, indicating firewall management on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n4) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for management.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is linked to the 'Azure Bastion' (n2) for management.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n14) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'DNS Server' (n4) for data flow.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n6) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for data flow, indicating URL filtering.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology shows a hub-and-spoke design with a central 'Hub VNet' (z1) containing security and management services, and multiple peered VNETs for different functions, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' (n15) and 'Secure Network Protocols' (n16) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), both linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for management.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is linked to the 'Azure Bastion' (n2) for management, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Bastion' (n2) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) for management, indicating remote device connection to AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n11) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is linked to the 'Azure Bastion' (n2) and 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for management, indicating dedicated administrative resources.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n7) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for monitoring.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology shows VNET peering links between the 'Hub VNet' (z1) and other VNETs (Identity, Operations, Workload, Non-Production), indicating traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is linked to the 'Azure Bastion' (n2) for management, indicating access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for monitoring, indicating collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n8) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for monitoring.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n10) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for management, indicating port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n9) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for data flow, indicating application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production VNet' (z6) and other VNETs (Identity, Operations, Workload) that are peered with the 'Hub VNet' (z1), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Service' (n17) in the 'Pen Testing' zone (z10), which is linked to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1) for data flow, indicating periodic external penetration testing.
